page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head at top. Right edge: fragments of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: rifimile Carthaginenfes Patres hoc Decretum fancituroc effe, nec Ecclefiarum confuetudinem memoraturos, fi extitisset tunc temporis Apoftolicus Canon qui folis Lectoribus & cantoribus uxores ducendi potestatem concedit. Canonem XXIX. contra Simoniacos expendimus & adversus Pearsonium demonstravimus nihil pro istius Syllogesantiquitatehinc[?] exsculpi posse; Tamen si Beveregio credimus hic Canon ipsis Tertulliani diebus observatus est, quoniam Tertulianus hæc scribit Apolog. cap. XXXIX. Præsident probati quique seniores honorem istum non pretio, sed testimonio adepti, neque enim pretio ulla res Dei constat: Fateor obtinuisse ipsis Tertuliani diebus sanctissimam hanc disciplinam, ut nemo per pecunias ad Ecclesiasticas promoveretur Dignitates; At inde sequi nego observatum fuisse tunc temporis Apostolicum Canonem: Immò ex hac Tertullianei ævi disciplinâ, & ex Canonibus S. Basilii & Concilii Chalcedonensis, & forsan aliis suum conflavit Planus ille qui istam Canonum farraginem consarcinavit. Argumentis ex Canonibus. XXXIV. XXXV. XLIX. L. desumptis occurrit Clarissimus Dallæus: Nos verò ea refellimus quæ ex XXXVII. XL. XLV. XLVII, descripta sunt. Cæteris quæ à triginta quinque postremis Canoni-

page.notes: Fragments of the neighbouring page at the right edge (bu, eti, eft, bu, Sy, tei, m, hu, fei, nc, qu, afi, th, re, de, læ, ve, ri, fu, ru) are the edge of the next page and were left out. Doubtful: "Syllogesantiquitatehinc" is printed with no word spaces and may be a spacing error; the "P" of "Præsident" is printed like a B. The last word "Canoni-" is a fragment continuing onto the next page. The lowercase-looking numerals (XXXIV, XXXV, etc.) are set in small capitals and are copied as capitals.
